title: Momentum Ledger — tiny wins & KPI micro-sprints
content:
Overview / intent:
- This is my small-format weekly ledger: capture tiny wins, quick metric checks, and 1–2 experiments to run next sprint. Meant to reduce friction of tracking so I actually keep momentum.
- Keep it short: top-of-week intent + end-of-week micro-retro. Use it as the canonical note for 1:1 and async updates.

This week (Mon 2026-03-09 -> Sun 2026-03-15):
1) Focus theme: cost-per-inference reduction experiments + reliability guardrails for canary.
2) Primary outcome I want: demonstrate 10% token-cost reduction on default routing for chat route without >1% user-latency regression (p95).

Quick snapshot metrics (manual checks / hairball queries):
- Default-chat route: baseline token cost avg ~$0.0078/token (Feb average).
- This morning (2026-03-10) after small batching tweak: ~0.0073/token (estimated) — provisional, needs proper billing correlate.
- P95 latency (region-us-west): baseline 210ms -> current 220ms (spike windows at 3pm).
- Serving errors: 0.04% 5xx last 24h (acceptable threshold 0.1%).

Micro-experiments to run this sprint (priority order):
A. Adaptive batching policy trial (A/B): 3-day canary on 5% traffic -> set max_batch_delay 12ms, enable prefork cache.
   - Hypothesis: reduce per-token cost by ~6% with <2% p95 increase.
   - Measurement plan: correlate token billing + tracing samples + p95 from telemetry; tag traces with experiment id AB-03.
   - Risk: cold-start bursts; mitigate by warmup schedule pre-rollout at 4am -> 8am.
B. KV prefix caching aggressive TTL on common prompts (gpt-open-16k-qr): 1-week rulebook; TTL default 30m -> 3h for recognized prefixes.
   - Hypothesis: cut repeated token work for FAQ/assist flows by ~12%.
   - Implementation note: coordinate with infra on cache invalidation endpoints; log invalidation events (INF-342).
C. Quantized variant routing for low-criticality routes: route to 8-bit quantized model when user opt-out flag = false.
   - Hypothesis: lower serving cost ~18% on routed traffic, but watch hallucination/regression.
   - Eval: run evaluation suite (prompt set: assist-200) and monitor quality delta >3% => roll back.

Top blockers / unresolved questions:
- Need a clean billing join query: current estimate is from local sampling. Ask Finance to share daily token-cost export for last 30 days (ticket: INF-499?).
- Who owns the canary rollout coordination during EMEA overlap? Pinged Maya; need on-call overlap plan.
- Cache invalidation semantics across Dedicated clusters — unclear if TTL can be globally enforced. Follow-up w/ Ishaan.

Mini-OKR draft (for personal perf + team contribution) — trimmed for 6-week cycle:
Objective: Deliver measurable cost and reliability improvements for chat inference that product teams can adopt by end of Q2.
Key Result 1: Reduce average token cost on default-chat route by 10% (measured vs Feb baseline).
Key Result 2: Maintain p95 latency within +5% of baseline for >=95% of traffic during rollouts.
Key Result 3: Ship two reliability automation rules (auto-fallback to fallback-variant + proxied region routing) and validate in two customer canaries.

Weekly commitments (this doc is my source of truth):
- Wed 2026-03-11: implement AB experiment harness + lightweight telemetry tag (2h dev, 1h test) — DONE (dev pushed, but tests flaky).
- Thu 2026-03-12: sync w/ infra on cache invalidation API (30m) — scheduled.
- Fri 2026-03-13: draft rollout plan and ops-runbook (3p doc).
- Next Mon: deploy canary to 5% (monitor first 6 hours intensively).

End-of-week micro-retro (to fill Sun night):
- Wins: small batching tweak seems promising; team responded quickly to instrumentation gap.
- Misses: lost a half-day due to flaky telemetry tests — action: add deterministic test for experiment tags.
- Learnings: measuring cost without billing join is slow; need a daily export to iterate faster.
- Adjustments: de-prioritize quantized routing until we have better evaluation thresholds; focus on batching + caching first.

Notes to self / 1:1 fodder with manager:
- Quick ask: can we get a Finance export for token-level cost per route for last 60 days? would speed iteration.
- Resource ask: 0.2 FTE infra support for 3 weeks to harden cache invalidation and warmup scripts.
- Career note: want to lead a small cross-functional spike to build the cost-observability cookbook (2 week prototype).

Loose links & artifacts to reference while working:
- INF-342 (canary instrumentation) — jira link above.
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/optimizely/pull/178 — contains AB harness prototype.
- Slack thread: #eng-momentum (2026-03-09) — where we debated default batch delay.

Tiny wins log (short, for morale):
- 2026-03-10: shaving 0.5c/token estimate after batch tweak — celebrated with quick team note.
- 2026-03-11: AB harness unit tests passing locally (after flakiness fix).
- 2026-03-12: Got a commit ack from infra to look at cache invalidation semantics.

Todo (short):
- [ ] Formalize billing join query + request to Finance.
- [ ] Add deterministic experiment tag test to CI.
- [ ] Finalize runbook + rollback steps.
- [ ] Schedule 30m alignment with Maya for EMEA canary overlap.

Random scribbles (brain dump):
- Could we try micro-batching on client side for fast chat UX? Maybe a client SDK opt-in flag that groups messages <10ms window. Edge case: human perceived latency.
- If we had per-route cost alerts (automated), we could stop manual daily checks. Implement idea for "cost guard" in console.

End note: keep this small-format ledger active; if an item grows beyond a day to manage, extract to a proper tracker (Jira/Confluence) and link from here.

-- Samira
